attchmntText: Harrisons  Malayalam Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication in Deshabhimani and Financial Express today.
voiceSummary: Harrisons Malayalam Limited has published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was filed on November 14, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. Newspaper advertisements were published in Financial Express and Deshabhimani. The document includes a financial table showing total income from operations of 1514.57 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 2592.00 for the same period in 2025. Net profit before tax was 200.48 for the current quarter versus 642.21 in 2025. Earnings per share were 1.82 for the current quarter compared to 3.48 in 2025. The text contains unrelated news snippets regarding Kerala politics, prices, and court cases which are not part of the corporate disclosure.

attchmntText: Harrisons  Malayalam Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Harrisons Malayalam Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. Gopal Rathi, DIN 00553066, as Additional Director, Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. His appointment is subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. Mr. Corattiyil Vinayaraghavan, DIN 01053367, ceased as Chairman upon tenure completion but continues as Non-Executive Independent Director. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 15,528.39 lakhs. Profit after tax was 280.68 lakhs. Earnings per share was 1.52. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 28,020.25 lakhs. Profit after tax was 674.33 lakhs. Earnings per share was 3.65. The meeting was held on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Harrisons  Malayalam Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Harrisons Malayalam Limited appointed Mr. Gopal Rathi, DIN 00553066, as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. The Board approved this appointment on November 13, 2026, following a recommendation from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Rathi is liable to retire by rotation. His appointment as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director is subject to shareholder approval within three months. The company confirmed that Mr. Rathi is not debarred from holding the office of director by SEBI or any other authority. He is also not disqualified under Section 164 of the Companies Act, 2013. Mr. Rathi has 25 years of experience in finance, business strategy, and mergers and acquisitions. He holds a bachelor’s degree in commerce from the University of Calcutta and is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He is not related to any existing director of the company.
